assumption: All candidate native token scalar queries require four output bytes.
basis: Win32 enumeration descriptions and PHNT annotations; provisional survey design.
stress-test: Record exact native NTSTATUS, ReturnLength and adjacent bytes for all selectors/profiles.
falsification-probe: A successful query returns a length other than four.
status: falsified: native64 class21 returns one byte; version2 measures length instead of asserting four

assumption: The selected primary token is immutable for the guest process lifetime.
basis: Existing process-runtime contract admits no token mutation or host-thread impersonation.
dependent-result: Guest queries can use captured metadata without host calls.
stress-test: Missing subject, missing property, mismatched token identity, unsupported impersonation and native repeated-capture disagreement.
falsification-probe: An admitted guest operation changes the selected token or one of its captured properties.

assumption: Native NtQueryInformationToken behavior must be measured separately from Win32 GetTokenInformation descriptions.
basis: Native class21 returned one byte; the Win32 enum describes a DWORD. The APIs are distinct.
dependent-result: Capture uses the native API and adapter decisions follow the native caller matrix.
stress-test: Compare status, width, access precedence and byte preservation across four caller profiles.
falsification-probe: A design decision relies only on the other API's description.
status: confirmed for the complete native survey; interfaces remain distinct

assumption: Four profiles on one ARM64 Windows kernel establish only that measured kernel/profile set.
basis: Each producer records RtlGetVersion, PE machine/LAA and source/binary identities.
dependent-result: No physical x64-kernel or universal Windows-version coverage claim.
stress-test: Complete ordered rows and post-run identity for every profile/selector.
falsification-probe: Missing producer, unfinished matrix or mismatched source/binary identity.
status: confirmed for the measured kernel and four caller profiles

assumption: Private-namespace values normalize every nonzero tested setter value to one.
basis: Twenty-four private-token value controls across four caller profiles.
dependent-result: Class42 is a Boolean-valued four-byte field, distinct from arbitrary session IDs.
stress-test: Zero, one, seven, 0x12345678, 0x80000000 and 0xffffffff; duplicate-token value and successful thread reversion.
falsification-probe: Any retained private control differs from zero-versus-nonzero normalization.
status: confirmed for tested values and kernel

assumption: A four-byte byte array on the Rust stack provides the native output alignment.
basis: Initial native capture and test oracle used [u8;4], whose type alignment is one; the measured API requires four-byte output alignment.
dependent-result: Native reference/capture calls must not depend on compiler stack placement.
stress-test: Changed stack layout or compiler optimization must retain valid aligned native pointers.
falsification-probe: Compare align_of::<[u8;4]>() with the measured four-byte requirement.
status: falsified for byte-array type alignment; revised to explicit u32 storage and confirmed by corrected focused and final validation
